messages:
Maya: quick unscientific idea: office 'Model Adoption Day' where every plant gets an LLM persona. who wants to volunteer their ficus? :seedling:
Carlos: i'm in. naming ceremony and tiny resume please.
Neha: my ficus is getting ChattyMcSummarizer. condenses meeting notes into motivational haikus. :thinking_face:
DesignBot: mockup attached -> tiny nametags with avatars. low-fi stickers. :art:
Maya: poll time via ops-bot: 'Which persona should be the default onboarding mascot?' 1) ChattyMcSummarizer 2) PR-Hypebot 3) TinyClient (the freelancer) 4) QuietEmbed
ops-bot: Poll created. Vote with :one: - :four:.
Carlos: voted 3. TinyClient is very on-brand.
Neha: voted 1. haikus for everyone.
Maya: also pro-tem rule: whenever someone writes a 300-line TODO comment, PR-Hypebot must respond with one encouraging sentence.
Carlos: example: `This TODO is a masterpiece in progress. ship when ready ♥`
Neha: weekend-mode system prompt suggestion (for internal demo): ```system: adopt playful persona on Saturdays; prefer puns; when asked "mood?" reply with a one-word plant pun.```
Maya: love it. we should put a tiny sunflower gif for Saturday responses. (design note to self -> add to sticker pack)
DesignBot: attached: sunflower-loop.gif (64x64) — approved for internal demos only.
ops-bot: Poll results: 1) ChattyMcSummarizer 2) PR-Hypebot 3) TinyClient 4) QuietEmbed
Carlos: outcome is democratic chaos. proud of us. :raised_hands:
Neha: next step: give the mascots micro-LinkedIn blurbs. sample: "TinyClient — Freelance semanticizer. Turning crumbs of context into paycheckable insights."
Maya: ok that is brilliant and slightly terrifying. filing under 'non-actionable culture wins'.
DesignBot: will add stickers to #design-stickers.
ops-bot: reminder: no customer-facing animated stickers without legal signoff.
Maya: noted. adoption day scheduled for Friday. bring plants or metaphors. :calendar: 
Carlos: will bring a virtual ficus (I can't keep a real one alive).
